title: Bahubali 2: The Conclusion
desc: After learning that his father was brutally killed by Bhallaladeva, Mahendra Baahubali raises an army to defeat him and release his mother from the former's captivity.

title: Kaamannana Makkalu
desc: With the help of his two sons, Kaamanna, a former thief, decides to start a new life on the right side of the law.

title: Sye
desc: Prudhvi and Shashank are rugby players who despise each other. However, they join forces to defeat a politician who wants to confiscate their college's land.

title: Mandya
desc: Ganesh, also known as Eshwar, is compelled to move to the city after the bloodshed in his native town devastates him. When he returns years later, he adopts the task of educating people.
